async.@description: Specifies that the script is executed asynchronously (only for external scripts)

charset.@description: Specifies the character encoding used in an external script file

defer.@description: Specifies that the script is executed when the page has finished parsing (only for external scripts)

src.@description: Specifies the URL of an external script file

type.@description: Specifies the media type of the script, default application/javascript
